source: Indian Sign Language Research and Training Centre (ISLRTC)

fix.phonological_description: Dual bent V-hands twisting and setting firmly into interlocking alignment.

realize.phonological_description: Index finger touches forehead then blossoms outward with sudden enlightenment.

notice.phonological_description: Dominant index finger taps near cheek/eye then points forward at focal object.

limit.phonological_description: Dual flat hands descending perpendicularly onto boundary markers.

substance.phonological_description: Dual curved claw hands held at chest kneading molecular matter.

cover.phonological_description: Dominant curved palm sweeps smoothly over stationary non-dominant fist shielding it.

risk.phonological_description: Dominant index finger slices diagonally across throat/chest in hazard warning.

safe.phonological_description: Dual S-fists crossed at wrists breaking outward into open protective shield.

guide.phonological_description: Non-dominant hand holds dominant fingertips gently leading forward.

memory.phonological_description: Open C-hand grasping near forehead and pulling backward into firm S-fist.

join.phonological_description: Dual open H/index fingers interlinking firmly at center midline.

explain.phonological_description: Dual F-hands alternating forward and backward in explanatory clarity.

complex.phonological_description: Dual claw hands intertwining fingers across midline indicating intricate knots.

nature.phonological_description: Dominant N/flat hand sweeping over non-dominant arm and blooming upward.

weather.phonological_description: Dual W-hands descending with oscillating finger flutter simulating atmosphere.

plant.phonological_description: Dominant hand emerging upward through non-dominant C-fist blossoming into open palm.

animal.phonological_description: Dual bent fingertips resting at chest/armpits with rhythmic breathing movement.

mountain.phonological_description: Dual fists tap together then ascend diagonally upward to form steep peak.

river.phonological_description: Dual open palms undulate forward along winding linear water current.

ocean.phonological_description: Dual open hands rolling in undulating expansive swell across signing space.

bridge.phonological_description: Left horizontal forearm steady; right V-hand taps under wrist and elbow.

market.phonological_description: Dual flat B-hands sweeping forward repeatedly simulating bustling trade stalls.

cost.phonological_description: Dominant crooked index finger brushes upward against vertical flat non-dominant palm.

rich.phonological_description: Dominant flat palm lifts from non-dominant palm ascending high with wealth flourish.

weak.phonological_description: Dominant V-fingers buckle and collapse against non-dominant flat palm.

heavy.phonological_description: Dual open upward palms drop downward with weighted effort and slight torso dip.

shadow.phonological_description: Dominant flat palm passes underneath horizontal non-dominant hand into darkness.

mirror.phonological_description: Dominant flat open palm faces face and oscillates gently examining reflection.

window.phonological_description: Dual horizontal flat hands (dominant above non-dominant) opening upward.

wall.phonological_description: Dual vertical flat palms held forward moving apart defining vertical solid partition.
